_source: Measured off the M_Light primitive of each kit .gltf - the emissive strip is the lamp, so the area light is placed on its face and sized to it.
_note: A SEED, not a derivation. These fire once, when a module is first placed; from then on the light belongs to that element, so an edit survives a save and a copy carries it. Changing this file never touches a ship that is already laid out.
_axes: Editor space. Babylon's glTF loader turns the file 180 degrees about Y and mirrors Z, which nets out to x_editor = -x_gltf, so the strip centres below are the .gltf values with X negated. A light emits along its own local -Y, and its rectangle lies in the local XZ plane: sizeX spans local X, sizeY spans local Z.

modules._Props/Prop_Light_Corner: A quarter-circle strip, centre [0.083, -0.08], radius 3.889, sweeping -87 to -2 degrees. An area light is flat, so the arc is served by three chord segments; the rotations are the tangent at each segment's midpoint.
modules._Props/Prop_Light_Floor: The only one that does not point down: its face is tilted 18 degrees off vertical, so it is turned 161.6 degrees about X to throw the light up the wall instead of at the floor it is standing on.
